name: cytoscape-lumina
description: LUMINA: a structure-aware Cytoscape.js layout that detects cycles, chains, stars and parallel groups and lays them out with force-directed or stress-majorization solvers.

scripts.build: tsc && cp src/favicon.ico dist/favicon.ico && cp src/index.html dist/index.html && cp node_modules/cytoscape/dist/cytoscape.min.js dist/ && if [ -d data ]; then cp -r data dist/data; fi && touch dist/.nojekyll
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently "tsc --watch" "node watch.cjs" "http-server dist -p 8080 -c-1"
